measuredBy: lane PF25, outside the builder, over the committed fixture bytes
whatThisIsNot: a RASTER_PASS. Only the central raster workflow issues one, bound to the exact SHA-256 recorded in reports/rendered-artifacts.json. No workflow was dispatched.
threshold: grey < 128 counts as a dark pixel, at 600 dpi, on 5100x6600 US-Letter pages
renderer: poppler pdftoppm 24.02.0, invoked as `pdftoppm -r 600 -gray -aa yes -f <page> -l <page> -png <pdf> <prefix>`. Poppler draws widget annotations and no flag suppressing them was passed.

howTheSourceWasRendered.why: A removed-dark-pixel count taken against an annotation-free render of a form that keeps ink inside widget /AP /N streams is worthless: both sides come up blank in the same places and the difference is zero by construction.
howTheSourceWasRendered.whatWasMeasuredHere: Both pinned sources were re-rendered with annotations drawn and again from a control copy built with pdf-lib with every page /Annots deleted and the catalog /AcroForm dropped, then differenced. CR-266: 1,073,979 dark pixels either way, difference 0. CR-267: 1,014,311 dark pixels either way, difference 0. Both binaries declare ZERO annotations and no AcroForm, so there is no widget ink for an annotation-free render to lose, and the 0 removed readings below are therefore real rather than an artefact of a blind render.
howTheSourceWasRendered.andTheRendererWasProvedToDrawAnnotationI: The identical command was run over an AcroForm-bearing control in the same custody -- private/source-imports/Nationwide_Recovery_Pool_2026-09-02/LegalEase West Virginia/SCA-C-903.pdf, sha256 242048f1ff5b2e795ca43900bec6d9c353c59950bffd3c7776374ff1cc6c7035, 2 pages, 25 fields -- and against a control copy of it with all 25 annotations removed. Page 1 renders 1,299,763 dark pixels normally and 1,263,998 with annotations removed; page 2 renders 610,904 and 602,058. 35,765 dark pixels on page 1 and 8,846 on page 2 are drawn by annotations ALONE. This renderer draws widget /AP /N ink, so a zero taken from it means something.
howTheSourceWasRendered.controlCopyBuiltBy: pdf-lib, page /Annots deleted and catalog /AcroForm dropped; used only as a control and never as a comparison baseline.

pageMapping: packet page 1 is CR-266 page 1, packet page 2 is CR-267 page 1; sources resolved by exact SHA-256 under MASTER_LIBRARY_SOURCE_DIR
bothDirections: added AND removed reported per page. Removed is 0 on EVERY page of BOTH fixtures: this build erased nothing.

negativeControls.whyRegionsAndNotPages: Each source is one page and this packet writes on both of them, so there is no untouched PAGE to use as a control. The controls below are REGIONS this build writes nothing in, each carrying hundreds of thousands of the court's own dark pixels, so a zero there is a live comparison and not an empty one.
